content:
TEMPTATION ||| Slide my fingers along the blade's edge ||| "Let’s see if they can handle the truth."  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, holding the blade firmly ||| "I won’t answer until you clarify what you mean."  
CONFESSION ||| Look directly at Julian, my voice steady ||| "Your presence here changes everything I thought I knew."  
REVERSAL ||| Grip the blade tighter, my resolve hardening ||| "I’ll determine what happens next, and you’ll support my choice."  
SILENCE ||| Hold the blade still, breathing deeply ||| *A steady breath, eyes locked on Seren.*
